census: PTDE/DSR Diffuse + Normal/Bump exact-resource semantic census
identity_policy: Resource presence is classified only from exact recovered route tuples. This census does not infer operator absence from MTD or texture names. Missing exact identity is UNKNOWN/fail-open.

diffuse_exact_resource_route.scope: each of the 528 exact spec_hash + diffuse_hash route rows in diffuse_routes_v12.tsv
diffuse_exact_resource_route.meaning: the exact routed material slot consumes the recovered diffuse resource target
does_not_prove: NO_USE for resources absent from this corpus

normal_bump_exact_resource_route.scope: each of the 557 exact diffuse_hash + spec_hash + normal_hash route rows in normal_routes_v12.tsv
normal_bump_exact_resource_route.meaning: the exact routed material slot consumes the recovered normal/bump resource target
does_not_prove: NO_USE for resources absent from this corpus

integration_policy: Join these resource-route facts into the unified MTD census only when the exact material-slot/FLVER ownership route is available. Do not upgrade a whole MTD family to USE or NO_USE from a texture-name heuristic.
